name: cosmas-os
install:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:/usr/local/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v uv >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh
fi
uv python install 3.13.15
uv sync --extra dev --extra efax-inbound --extra mcp --extra calendar-import
need_node=0
if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  need_node=1
else
  major=$(node -p 'process.versions.node.split(".")[0]')
  if [ "$major" != "24" ]; then
    need_node=1
  fi
fi
if [ "$need_node" = "1" ]; then
  curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v24.19.0/node-v24.19.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | sudo tar -xJ -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --no-same-owner
fi
sudo corepack enable
./scripts/install-client-deps.sh
if ! command -v pg_ctl >/dev/null 2>&1 || ! command -v pg_config >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y postgresql-16
fi
if ! command -v redis-server >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo apt-get update
  sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y redis-server
fi
